relationship.description: a relationship known between two people

base.description: the persona this one is worn on, whose text and documents come first; it may be kept in another store, which whoever wears this one reads it from

persona.description: instructions an agent runs with: the doc body on the same entity is the instruction text

persona_read.title: Read a persona
persona_read.description: Read a persona (a named set of agent instructions) by id or name. Returns one markdown document: its own instruction text, then the full text of every document it includes, then one line naming each document it only references. This is the text an agent is given; where it goes (a file, a repository, a spawned agent’s system prompt) is up to the caller.

persona.description: the persona’s unique entity id (eid), human-readable id, registered name, or exact title

persona_sync.title: Write the persona files
persona_sync.description: Write each project’s personas into its checkout, where a harness started there reads them: the persona the project contains as .tasks/AGENTS.md (a repository’s CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md link to it), and every other persona whose home is the project as .tasks/personas/<name>.md (the sync links .claude/agents/<name>.md to it, and removes a link into .tasks/personas no file wants). Only a file whose text moved is written; the file of a renamed or deleted persona is removed; a file edited by hand while the graph also moved is left alone and reported. Returns one line per file it wrote, removed or left, and per link it made or removed.

check.description: write nothing: report the files that would change

persona_files.description: write the persona files again: a persona, its home, text a persona says in doc or content, a link carrying or reading it (read by the ends it had once it is gone), or a project with a repository archived or restored moved

invoke.description: who may load the skill; both when omitted

arguments.description: the argument names the skill accepts

paths.description: the path globs the skill applies under

fork.description: run in a context of its own

options.description: other Claude frontmatter options, preserved without interpreting or executing them

skill.description: instructions loaded on demand: doc.title is the name and folder, doc.body the description an agent decides by, content.body the instructions. A references edge points to its repository file; names do not determine its identity

skill_files.description: reconcile skills, their repository files and reference links when skills mirroring is enabled; exports land through a dedicated worktree

skill_watch.description: reconcile repository skill files at startup and while the filesystem changes, only when skills mirroring is enabled
